thread:
Nora: Heads-up: I'm opening a focused PR to land the canonical glossary + migration notes for SDK v1.2. Aim is minimal churn but clear mappings for external users. I'll include sample-before/after snippets and a short `changelog/migration.md`.
Sam: 👍 Please include a compact table of mappings in the repo root `/docs/glossary/mappings.md` (machine and human readable).
Nora: Plan: mappings file, `migration.md`, update all quickstart snippets, add a remark-lint rule to fail on deprecated terms, and a small CI job that runs `scripts/check_terms.sh`.
Priya: For quick validation, can you include a small python script that replaces phrases and reports changed files? That will help reviewers reproduce locally.
Nora: Yep, dropping the script in `tools/term-migrate.py`. Example command in PR: `python tools/term-migrate.py --apply --terms docs/glossary/mappings.csv`
Eli: Suggest the canonical mappings be lowercase for ease in grep, e.g. `model line` not `Model Line`. Keep product names Capitalized only on marketing pages.
Nora: Agreed. We'll use lowercase in mappings and add a short note about capitalization rules in `mappings.md`.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/513 (labels: docs, glossary, migration)
Sam: Also add a small unit test in `docs/tests/test_terms.py` that scans changed files in the PR and fails if deprecated tokens are still present. Keeps CI useful.
Priya: Migration note idea: show a two-column code diff for common patterns. e.g. old SDK call -> new SDK call with renamed params. Short, copy/pasteable.
Nora: Example snippet I'll include in migration.md:
```diff
- client.create_endpoint(name="my-endpoint", model_family="gptx", dedicated_capacity=2)
+ client.create_endpoint(name="my-endpoint", model_line="gptx", dedicated=2)
```
Eli: Also add a one-liner about compatibility window: "v1.1 runtime will accept old names until 2026-09-30; please migrate by then." Tag product for exact date.
Nora: Will tag product/support. I'll also include the sed/glob commands for reviewers under "How to test":
```bash
# find occurrences
rg --hidden --glob '!node_modules' -n "model_family|dedicated_capacity|best-effort endpoint" || true
# apply safe replacements (preview)
python tools/term-migrate.py --preview --terms docs/glossary/mappings.csv
```
Sam: Nice. Keep changes split: 1) mappings & tests, 2) remark-lint rule, 3) snippet updates. That will make reviews faster.
Priya: I'll volunteer to do the quickstart snippets sweep after the mappings land. I can open a follow-up PR with only quickstart edits.
ora: (small typo) meant to tag Priya earlier, thanks.
Nora: Targeting merge next Tue if no blockers. If anyone wants a heads-up email to customers once merged, say so and we'll draft it. :mailbox_with_mail:
Eli: Yes please; I'll draft a short customer note (one paragraph + migration link).
docs-bot: CI status: pending (once PR is created tests will run).
Nora: Great — PR body will include checklist: update mappings.md, add migration.md, add tools/term-migrate.py, add CI job, and follow-up quickstart PR. Thanks all!
